row:
Purpose  – to provide quality information on common back and neck issues of horses and dogs. 
Intro - In an era where misinformation and traditional misunderstanding is rife amongst our printed and online sources this channel is aimed at providing a more balanced, much more scientific view on back and neck pain in dogs and horses. The information is built on 40 odd years of ongoing study and practical experience as a veterinarian working with horses and dogs, with the last 25 years being dedicated to problems related to upper body (especially back and neck) pain and dysfunction.
Topics to be pursued - In horses: Sacroiliac joint pain, Girthy horses, Saddle Fitting problems, Horses not forward, Irregularity of gait, poll shyness, Head tossing, Shoulder and hip strain.  In Dogs:  Paralyzed dogs, Disc disease, Yelping in pain, Stiff back, Loss of ability to Jump, Cruciate ligament strain, Hip dysplasia. Elbow dysplasia.   Equine and Canine Acupuncture, Equine and Canine Chiropractic.
